name: Tuna Fried Rice with Corn
steps: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat the cooked rice, add corn and frozen vegetables, and stir‑fry.
Mix in the canned tuna, season with salt, and continue cooking until everything is hot.
Serve while steaming.
image_prompt: golden fried rice grains mixed with bright yellow corn kernels and flaked canned tuna, speckled with a light dusting of salt

name: Black Bean & Corn Rice Bowl
steps: Place rice and corn in a microwave‑safe bowl, add water and microwave until fluffy.
Stir in the cooked black beans, crumbled tofu, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Microwave for another minute to heat everything through.
Mix well and serve hot.
image_prompt: fluffy white rice topped with black beans, sweet yellow corn kernels, and crumbled tofu cubes, with a sprinkle of cumin

name: Lentil & Corn Soup with Rice
steps: Rinse lentils and simmer them in water until tender.
Add corn, canned tomatoes, curry powder and salt; continue simmering.
Cook rice separately and set aside.
Poach the egg in the soup broth for 3‑4 minutes.
Ladle soup over a bed of rice and serve.
image_prompt: steaming broth with orange lentils, yellow corn kernels, diced tomatoes, and a poached egg floating above a mound of rice

name: Egg & Corn Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
In a pan, scramble the eggs, then push to the side.
Add corn and rice to the pan, stir‑fry together.
Fold the scrambled eggs back in, heat through and serve.
image_prompt: bright yellow corn kernels and fluffy rice tossed with scrambled egg ribbons, with small cubes of tofu visible

name: Tofu & Corn Stir‑fry with Rice
steps: Cook rice and keep warm.
Cube the tofu and stir‑fry in a pan until lightly browned.
Add corn, black beans and lentils; stir‑fry for another 3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and salt, then serve over the rice.
image_prompt: glossy cubes of tofu and sweet corn kernels stir‑fried over a bed of white rice, glistening with soy sauce

name: Sardine & Corn Rice Patties
steps: Cook rice and mix with corn, flaked sardines, beaten egg, crushed crackers and salt.
Form the mixture into patties.
Pan‑fry the patties in a non‑stick pan over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Serve hot.
image_prompt: golden‑fried rice and corn patties studded with flaked sardine pieces, with a golden egg yolk center visible
